title: The Imp Thief
text: An imp darts through camp in a blur of claws and cackling, quicker than a cat, and is gone into the dark with a House's purse in its teeth. You can hear it laughing somewhere out there, and the clink of coins being counted.

options.label: The quickest gives chase into the dark, determined to get the purse back.

outcomes.text: Caught by the tail, with its whole stash, still cackling.
Into its nest, and it was not alone, and it was never really running.

options.label: Let it go. Chasing an imp into the dark is a fool's errand.

outcomes.text: Lighter, and wiser, and its laughter carries a long way.

options.label: The cleverest baits a trap with more gold, and lets greed do the rest.

outcomes.text: It comes back for seconds, greedy, and leaves the first purse in the trap.
